_comment: SCHEMA of the github-kit fan-out registry, with placeholder names. The LIVE registry is NOT a file in this repository: it is the FANOUT_TARGETS repository Actions variable of github-kit (github-kit is public; the list of repositories it maintains is not). Read, validate and store it with scripts/fanout-registry.sh (get / check FILE / set FILE); a local working copy belongs at .github/fanout-targets.json, which is gitignored so it can never be committed. Per entry: 'repo' is required (owner/name). 'base' is optional: the branch the auto-update draft PR targets (a repo's integration branch); when omitted the target's default branch is resolved at run time via the GitHub API. 'install' (optional, default false): a target that does not have the kit installed yet (no docs/ai/PROJECT_CONFIG.md) is skipped with a log line and no PR unless install is true, in which case the full kit is installed on the first run. 'tier' (optional, default 1) is the Actions-budget tier the fan-out writes into the repo's CI callers: 1 = CI and verify run automatically on production-bound changes; 2 = they run only when dispatched by hand (see README.md -> 'Repository tiers'). 'variables' (optional): repository Actions variables for that repo, applied by a human with scripts/apply-repo-variables.sh (never by CI). KIT_AUTOMERGE_ALLOW_NO_CHECKS=true lets a PR a person marked ready merge when no check ran on it, which is the normal state of a PR into the working branch because the kit's CI runs only for production-bound changes; set it to false for a repo that must never merge without a check. github-kit itself is never a target. Add a repo by adding an entry to the live registry; nothing is needed on the target side.
